title: LangChain Design Agent: on-brand videos from Slack

facts.method: Official README pinned to 6 November 2026 commit
facts.limits: Hosting and model usage can cost money; human design review remains important.

scenes.say: LangChain built a design agent that turns a Slack request into on-brand videos.
scenes.heading: YOUR BRAND, IN SLACK

scenes.say: Give it your brand colors, fonts and spacing. Ask in Slack, and it can make graphics, decks, or motion videos.
scenes.heading: TEACH IT YOUR BRAND

scenes.say: It chooses a workflow, builds the work in code, then renders and checks colors, contrast and chart math before sending it back.
scenes.heading: FROM ASK TO OUTPUT

scenes.say: LangChain says it shipped over three thousand assets, and its median model spend fell from eight dollars a request to just fifty cents. That's their report, not a guarantee.
scenes.heading: THE VENDOR’S OWN NUMBER

scenes.say: The code is open source. The managed Slack setup needs a LangSmith account and a model key. Costs can apply, and a designer still needs to judge the result.
scenes.heading: THE HONEST CATCH

scenes.say: Would you trust it with your brand? Comment DESIGN and I'll pin the repo.
scenes.heading: YOUR CALL

youtube.title: LangChain Design Agent Makes On-Brand Videos
youtube.description:
LangChain’s open-source Design Agent can build graphics, decks and motion videos from a Slack request using a brand pack. LangChain reports over 3,000 assets and a reduction in median model spend from about $8 to $0.50 per request; these are its own historical figures, not a guarantee. The managed Slack setup needs a LangSmith account and a model key. Costs and human review still matter.

Source: https://www.langchain.com/blog/design-agent
Repo: https://github.com/langchain-ai/design-agent
#Shorts #AITools #DesignAgent
